---
title: Test upload (staging)
---
::: {.callout-warning}
This way of submission will be deprecated and no longer supported after February 2027.
:::

Before the real upload, upload a small test dataset to the **staging**
environment, so you don't have to re-upload terabytes if something is wrong.

## Do it

1. Pick **two images** and generate their metadata per
   [Prepare data](prepare-data.qmd). Include all XML files, the `PRIVATE` folder
   (always required), and the `LANDING_PAGE` folder (if you want a landing page).
2. Follow steps 1–3 of [Upload (sda-cli)](upload.qmd), but log in at the
   [staging service](https://login.staging.bp.nbis.se/) instead of production,
   so your `s3cmd-inbox.conf` points at staging.

{{< include /datasets/submission/_staging-warning.qmd >}}

::: {.callout-tip}
## Verify

`sda-cli` reports each file as it finishes uploading, with no errors. Only then
upload the full dataset to production.
:::

## If something goes wrong

- **Upload rejected or credential errors** — check that your
  `s3cmd-inbox.conf` was downloaded from the
  [staging service](https://login.staging.bp.nbis.se/), not production.
